plugins.name: Codex Quota Reserve
plugins.description: Codex OAuth quota reserve with optional CPA account disable/recovery, bounded automatic request budgets, quota history, in-plugin Webhook settings and scheduled usage reports. Shared model overload/capacity failures fail over without account cooldown; real 429 limits remain account-scoped. Requires CPA v8.0.27.
plugins.author: songka; based on Jeffery's Codex Quota Scheduler
